name: ForthWrite
description:
ForthWrite drafts emails and messages in your own writing voice. Connect Claude to your ForthWrite account, then ask for a reply or look up a known contact. Claude gets back text only. ForthWrite never sends the message. You review, edit, and paste it into Gmail, Outlook, or Slack yourself.

Two tools: Draft as user writes a voice-matched draft from the thread plus an optional steer. Contact context is a read-only lookup by email, Slack id, or LinkedIn handle. A first name or company is not enough.

Free accounts can connect. Drafting needs a Standard or Pro plan. There is no separate Claude fee. Disconnect anytime from Connections in ForthWrite or from Claude's connector settings.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ForthWrite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ForthWrite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.forthwrite.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ForthWrite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ForthWrite provides these MCP tools: contact_context and draft_as_user.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ForthWrite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ForthWrite in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
ForthWrite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ForthWrite is developed by ForthWrite. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
